name: Austin Furry Burlesque
description: Austin Furry Burlesque (AFB) was a proposed 18+ furry convention organized by Austinfurs, the group behind the monthly Park Bark meetup and the Austin Furry Dance. Planned for January 8 to 9, 2021, at the Austin-Pflugerville Courtyard Marriott in Texas, it was themed after a stage burlesque show, nodding to Austin's strong queer community, with a drag show and fashion-themed events such as a fursuit catwalk alongside a dealers' den, artists' alley and panels. The 2021 event did not take place, and registrations were refunded.
